title: Mann Group
description: manngroup.com.au Mann Group is an Australian multi-disciplinary engineering and construction company founded in 1992 in Sydney, operating through eight subsidiaries including Mechtronic Engineering, Mann Fab, Mann Energy, Mann Enviro and Mann Solar. With 350 plus employees, it is Australia's leading provider of thermal, electrical, environmental and sanitary engineering solutions. The group covers pipe fabrication, structural steel, pressure vessels, industrial boilers, HVAC, waste-to-energy and renewable energy systems. Its headquarters and central workshop are located in Milperra, Sydney, with a financial year ending in June.
